result:
Mine is the only `*AgentTest.java` in the project, and all 25 tests pass.

Created `src/test/java/org/apache/commons/lang3/text/ExtendedMessageFormatAgentTest.java` with 25 self-contained JUnit 5 tests covering: plain patterns, null pattern, unterminated/invalid format elements (with and without a registry), custom `FormatFactory` registry usage, unknown format names, quoted literal text, unmatched quotes, mixed custom/standard formats, all four disabled `setFormat*` methods (`UnsupportedOperationException`), `equals`/`hashCode` contract (including non-equal, non-`ExtendedMessageFormat`, and `null` cases), locale handling, `parse` round-tripping, choice subformats, empty patterns, whitespace handling around argument indices, and null-registry fallback to standard formats.
